svg.title: Reducing a planar Gaussian partition to three cones
svg.desc: A sampled irregular eight-cell partition is merged by nonnegative moment dot products until three cells remain. Reassigning points to their best old moment vector yields three angular cones and increases the sampled score. Exact proof and known-prior-art limits are in the companion note.
svg.text: From irregular cells to three cones
A sampled illustration of an exact planar reduction · family 096 · Lattice
Finite Gaussian sample: scores need not lie below the population bound 9/(8π).
